notes: Baseline selected static concept retained; new appearance mechanics/numerical levels not established.
Two new named appearance proposals, not approved equipment levels, world unlocks or balance; baseline remains unchanged.
VC01/VC02 remain unresolved source-precedence questions; no cargo-transfer policy or general in-camp blade behavior is chosen by this appearance proposal.
families.invariants: Preserve exact cab, four wheels and original wheelbase, cargo bed, ground clearance, front width, blade radius and low HORIZONTAL blade orientation. Fits the retained garage bay. No enlarged circular saws, vertical blades, weapons, extra axles, bigger cargo capacity claim or numerical stats. Low fuel consumption remains current; its appearance creates no new mandatory item or fuel dependency.

mechanics_approval_scope: This package inventories historical source forms and proposes new appearances. It neither grants new upgrade mechanics approval nor revokes any historical approval.
